reasoning: On the season so far the Grizzlies are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 2 points better, in a game of about 234 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Lakers.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Grizzlies.
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 56 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 208 and 256 total points.
